create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms molecule directly
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent index from the pickle database
create_solvent_with_density: create a Solvent object with a custom density value in grams per cm3
get_molecules_per_volume: get the number of solvent molecules per angstrom cubed using the molecules_per_volume property
get_solvent_molar_mass: get the molar mass of a Solvent object by summing atomic masses
